# Convergence and Development-Cycle Economy

Convergence exists to stop repeated low-value repair cycles. It is subordinate to governing abstraction/external authority and minimum justified concretization complexity; recurrence must not turn an accidental concretization mechanism into an invariant. Project Engineering Memory (PEM) may preserve evidence-backed recurrence and positive engineering learning, but remains non-authoritative; detailed PEM representation is owned by [Project Engineering Memory](project-engineering-memory.md).

## Core progression

```text
first clean local defect
    -> direct owning-layer repair

material sibling recurrence
    -> stop isolated instance patching; reason at the shared owner/mechanism

structural complexity accumulation
    -> re-derive and simplify the delegated concretization before further additive durable repair

post-simplification recurrence, or evidence governing abstraction is wrong
    -> bounded reconsideration of the earliest affected abstraction
```

A **first clean local defect remains local**. It does not require a census, matrix, family artifact, PEM entry, or redesign merely because similar bugs are imaginable.

## Semantic defect families and stable identity

A semantic defect/failure family is a bounded set of materially equivalent manifestations sharing a governing invariant, semantic owner/authority class, and materially equivalent repair-relevant failure mechanism. Family membership is not textual similarity, and broad subsystem labels, filenames, error strings or issue labels are not valid families by themselves.

When represented durably in PEM, an accepted family identifier has a **semantic identity envelope**: kind, governing invariant/claim, owner class, causal/mechanistic family, and materially relevant applicability dimensions. Wording may improve inside that envelope. A materially different family meaning requires explicit split/merge/supersession/replacement lineage; accepted identifiers are not recycled. Current lineage must remain acyclic and resolve each accepted historical identity to an unambiguous current disposition.

Family reasoning answers which manifestations share one engineering cause; it **does not answer whether the current concretization should survive**. Recurrence around a complicated mechanism is evidence to challenge that delegated concretization, not evidence that the mechanism has become authority.

Safe/disconfirming evidence that a failure cause or regime is too broad narrows, splits or reclassifies the family; it does not erase a genuine historical occurrence merely because current guidance changed.

## Occurrence and recurrence counting

A failure **occurrence** is one independently introduced or independently existing confirmed causal episode in the family. Many failing tests, stack traces, files or symptoms caused by one episode count as one occurrence plus multiple affected surfaces. Copied/cherry-picked manifestations of the same causal episode do not multiply it.

A later episode counts as **recurrence after accepted repair** only when the project can establish the relevant earlier repair and its acceptance, followed by a materially independent reintroduction/existence of the family cause. Commit timestamps, issue dates, rebases, cherry-pick order, file modification time or narrative chronology alone cannot establish recurrence. Preserve immutable project/repair/qualification identities needed to reconstruct the causal lineage.

Split/merge reallocates existing occurrence identities to canonical current families rather than summing parent and child counters. Occurrence count, recurrence-after-repair count, affected-surface breadth and lifecycle context are separate derived statistics.

## Positive application episodes

For a durable success pattern, count one **evaluated application episode** per materially distinct engineering intervention, not per changed file, executed test, rerun, deployment surface or benchmark sample. One coordinated intervention propagated across many surfaces is one application episode with a separate affected-surface breadth. A later materially distinct application may increment once.

Record all materially applicable evaluated outcomes—supporting, neutral, contradicting and inconclusive—and retain rejected/invalid episodes when needed to understand the evidence history. Before admitting or materially strengthening positive guidance, perform a bounded search for counterevidence in the declared aggregation/coverage scope so favorable history is not cherry-picked. Evidence independence/common-mode/provenance clustering is owned by the evidence reference.

Absolute success and comparative preference are different claims: evidence that a pattern works in a stated regime does not establish that it is preferred/default/best overall. Overlapping current patterns that recommend incompatible actions must narrow regimes, expose a decision/tradeoff predicate or current-owner priority, or remain contested/review-required.

## When bounded family closure is justified

Use a bounded family census/closure basis when either:

- the actual **governing parent/external correctness claim is finite/exhaustive**, and correctness depends on all members satisfying one invariant; or
- **bounded sibling discovery is needed** to remove, consolidate, or canonicalize the affected concretization safely and prevent obvious equivalent bypasses.

Bound by governing invariant, semantic owner, transition/lifecycle class, and plausible affected chain rather than the whole repository. A temporary closure map may be used when completeness itself establishes a real claim; it is not a universal persistent artifact.

Do not require completion of an existing "canonical concretization" merely because previous work selected it. First ask whether that concretization is still the minimum justified way to satisfy governing authority. A simpler equivalent concretization may replace the family mechanism entirely.

## Active simplification trigger

Active simplification/re-derivation is **mandatory before another additive durable repair** when evidence shows repeated patches around the same mechanism, patch-on-patch repair, wrappers/adapters/retries/fallbacks/special cases accumulating around one owner, duplicated/synchronized authoritative state, competing authorities, repeated reconciliation machinery, family closure that does not reduce the failure surface, or an evident materially simpler equivalent concretization.

The simplification pass holds governing parent semantics and external constraints fixed, then treats lower-level machinery as replaceable. Prefer removing, narrowing, altering, consolidating, or refactoring causes of intermediate problems. Add machinery only when a required capability genuinely remains absent or one canonical mechanism replaces broader existing complexity.

If the simpler solution would change an accepted parent abstraction or cycle-scoped decision, stop dependent work and route to bounded reconsideration rather than silently changing it. For D3 this is bounded Software Design reconsideration; for D1 or D2 use the corresponding scientific/numerical owner.

## Evidence recurrence versus defect recurrence

Repeated red tests can indicate a recurring defect family, but repeated test activity can also indicate stale evidence machinery. Before preserving or multiplying a test family, distinguish:

- one valid evidence specification exposing several manifestations of the same current defect;
- several specifications with independent evidentiary value;
- repeated executions of one specification under different candidates/regimes;
- stale concretization-specific tests whose target or real owner no longer matches current authority.

A passing stale test cannot justify closure; a failing stale test is not current refutation. If recurrence comes from obsolete evidence coupling rather than product behavior, remap/retire the evidence at its own owner instead of patching production code around it.

## Review readiness and independent review sufficiency

Normal final review should challenge a candidate Implementation has actually completed. Review readiness includes accepted-contract reconciliation, required stage-local/final affected regression, real-boundary integration where material, repository/project-required checks, task-required structural/absence/liveness evidence, and bounded impact closure when authority/concretization changes affected descendants/evidence/documentation.

Missing required closure/evidence is implementation nonconformance, not an automatic authority revision. An **explicitly requested review still proceeds** to the highest useful depth available.

When a blocker implicates a semantic family, the reviewer should proportionately inspect cheap, high-information sibling variants far enough to characterize the shared issue, then route one family-level problem rather than intentionally returning one cheap sibling per review cycle. Stop when further discovery becomes implementation-like, expensive/unavailable, mainly duplicates the systematic work Implementation must perform, or lacks an evidence-driven affected chain. Review sufficiency is not proof of zero conceivable defects.

A materially relevant PEM family is a high-information hypothesis source, not a verdict. The reviewer independently verifies current owner, applicability, assembled candidate and evidence; neither family temperature nor historical recurrence substitutes for current conformance evidence.

## Finding routing and revision economy

Route by engineering meaning and earliest semantic owner, not cycle count:

- an already-binding governing requirement/acceptance miss -> concretization nonconformance under the same authority;
- a genuinely missing/incorrect child abstraction -> reconcile that owning domain before the next handoff;
- newly discovered affected behavior under existing authority -> incorporate implementation/validation impact without minting new upstream requirements;
- evidence accepted authority itself may be materially false, contradictory, ambiguous, inadequate, or impossible to concretize -> Serious Challenge to the earliest affected owner;
- an unrelated pre-existing issue -> keep separate unless the active change exposes, depends on, or materially interacts with it.

Concrete new sites, call stacks, examples, failing inputs, or sibling manifestations are evidence rather than new normative semantics when current authority already governs them.

**Ordinary implementation attempts and review cycles do not require a numbered authority revision.** Existing-obligation misses, failed/unexecuted tests, additional violating sites, implementation patches, simpler equivalent concretization, generated-derivative regeneration, or clearer non-normative evidence do not by themselves mint task semantics.

**No recurrence count, review count, cycle budget, or convergence target can force acceptance**; memory temperature cannot force acceptance either; escalation changes the engineering method, **not the pass threshold**.

## Development-cycle economy

After fidelity and concretization simplicity are protected, minimize total cycle cost: diagnose before broad editing; search obvious variants before repeated instance patching; consolidate coherent edits before broad reruns; run cheap discriminating checks before broader regression/integration; reuse evidence whose claim/applicability cannot plausibly change; consult material project learning rather than replaying cold history; review deltas rather than settled archaeology; and avoid requesting another comprehensive closure review until identified blocker families and material impact items are closed where dependencies permit.

PEM should reduce repeated rediscovery, not create mandatory scan cost. Normal routes use compact summary + bounded applicability metadata when triggered and load only matched detail. Raw cold-history growth should not proportionally increase ordinary active context or maintenance work. Missing/partial memory cannot prove absence, so bounded historical intake remains available when the decision requires stronger exclusion.

Optional Serena/Semgrep/CodeQL/Hypothesis use can reduce rediscovery when their relation matches the claim. Tool absence does not relax required closure, and tool presence does not create a mandatory multi-tool census.

## Semantic evolution history and project engineering memory

When recurrence reveals that a model, algorithm, architecture, delegated mechanism, or evidence specification was already replaced/rejected for a material reason, preserve or consult concise semantic-evolution history so later agents do not rediscover the same dead end. History records why; current authority still defines what governs now.

PEM may retain a compact evidence-backed failure family, positive pattern, discovery, preservation capability, or temporary current notice when the lesson is likely to change later engineering decisions. Do not convert ordinary fix chronology into a permanent ledger. Admission requires a stable bounded lesson plus suitable durable evidence and applicability; unsupported speculation remains a hypothesis/workplan note rather than current project memory.

When a project lesson is promoted into generic current doctrine at its real owner, PEM should retire duplicate active guidance and keep only project-specific evidence/context that still changes decisions. Never use repeated local success to promote a mechanism into authority without the owner's acceptance process.

## Milestone stabilization after converged work

After substantial converged work, a bounded **non-mutating stabilization** pass may inspect duplicate authority/state, wrapper/fallback/special-case accumulation, stale compatibility, ownership drift, unnecessary public/configuration surface, internal states that mostly manage other machinery, stale evidence tied to superseded owners, and a materially simpler equivalent concretization.

If simplification is justified, route the minimum coherent change through the owning D1/D2/D3/D4 domain and fresh affected acceptance. If accepted D3 architecture must change, use bounded Software Design reconsideration; if D1/D2 authority is implicated, route there instead. Do not manufacture refactoring solely because stabilization exists.
